title: Structural '@tool' pin is satisfied by a doc comment, so it cannot fail
evidence:
tests/test_editor_preview.gd:22: 	check(src.contains("@tool"), "main.gd is @tool (runs inside the editor)")
scripts/main.gd:1: @tool
scripts/main.gd:8: ## @tool + "Regenerate Preview" (folded QoL): in the EDITOR the inspector
detail: The source-substring assertion matches the doc comment on main.gd:8, so removing the real annotation on line 1 would leave the pin green — its mutation leg is vacuous.
recommended_fix: Assert on structure, not text: e.g. check src.lstrip().begins_with("@tool"), or strip comments before substring-matching all three structural pins.
